title: Standardize billing & telemetry request workflow for enterprise console analytics
creator: Sofia Gómez
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submitting ad-hoc requests for billing breakdowns, scheduled telemetry exports, and SLA-backed dashboards have inconsistent requirements; PM and Eng time is spent clarifying scope. We need a repeatable intake + triage workflow to: 1) capture required data schema/fields (cost by route/model, token granularity, timezones), 2) classify requests by SLA/throughput/security constraints, and 3) map each request to a prioritized delivery path (self-serve template, product backlog, or professional services).

Scope: produce an intake form, triage rubric, priority matrix (business impact X engineering effort), and connectors for scheduled exports (CSV/Parquet) and BI-ready API endpoints. Deliverables: intake form (Confluence + web form), triage playbook, example templates for common enterprise needs (monthly cost-attribution, per-team token usage, reserved capacity amortization), and engineering acceptance criteria for export endpoints (schema, pagination, retention).

Success metrics: reduce back-and-forth clarifying questions by 60% within 2 cycles; 80% of new enterprise requests categorized into 'self-serve', 'backlog', or 'professional services' at intake; time-to-first-delivery from intake for P1 enterprise reports <= 6 weeks.

Stakeholders: Finance (cost modeling), Solutions Engineering (customer scoping), Security (data controls), Observability team (metric instrumentation), and Design (UX for console export flows).
